'''Tree vipers''' were [[Poison/Legends|venomous]] [[Snake/Legends|serpents]] from the jungles of [[Najarka]]. Their bite caused paralysis; individuals paralyzed by the venom had to receive a general [[anti-toxin]] within eight minutes to avoid irreversible brain damage.
